card.name: Adjectives before a general noun
card.fires_on: Plain adjectives like basic, key, simple, useful, serious or complex that come right after "a", "other" or a number and lead into a general noun. It also fires on the word "Principles" in a book title.

modes.label: Adjective before noun
modes.description: A general adjective after an article or quantity, before a noun such as function, form or changes.

modes.label: Book title words
modes.description: A word in a title or subtitle just before "and Practice" or a colon.
